contract_answer.question: Does the NA-E006 configuration (NaFadeNet + gated fade extrapolation) also improve on the parent NaFadeNet on paper split 42?
contract_answer.conclusion: Recomputed from the 600 saved predictions (lead draft; Codex usage limit reached, reviewer re-check pending): MAPE 0.181909 vs parent NA-E004 0.206247, RMSE 52.3 vs 58.1 cycles, Acc@15 0.450 vs 0.383. Prefix MAPE 0.236/0.201/0.185/0.162/0.165 improves in every band. Bias -25.9 vs -28.7 cycles; spread 0.48 vs 0.47 stays compressed. Worst cells 1-8-57 0.306 and 5-3-37 0.281 (were 0.317 and 0.350).

main_symptom: Split-42 confirmation keeps the NA-E006 gain (-0.0243 MAPE vs parent) but the extreme-EOL cells remain compressed toward the train mean (spread 0.48, bias -25.9 cycles).

contradicting_evidence: The gate block is connected and updates: diagnostics.json$.summary.layer_health.gate reports HEALTHY with late grad/parameter ratio 0.002271 and late update ratio 0.000149.
Prefix 11-25 MAPE regresses by 0.007056, so a fixed blend is not uniformly helpful.
causes.interpretation: The most supported explanation for the screen gain is that injecting a small, nearly fixed extrapolation component corrects part of NaFadeNet's underprediction. Overall relative bias improves from -0.118619 to -0.094141, and the largest cell gains occur on 270040-4-2-47 (MAPE 0.237279 to 0.167063) and 270040-3-2-55 (0.208841 to 0.173254). The flat gate and near-initial extrapolation calibration show that this is not learned reliability selection.
missing_evidence: A matched fixed-g=0.12 ablation to determine whether the 99-parameter gate contributes beyond the constant blend.
The same configuration and fixed-blend control on splits 42 and 2024.

contradicting_evidence: Checkpoint gate means are 0.119412/0.120110/0.120184/0.120240/0.120294 across the five prefix bands, effectively unchanged from sigmoid(-2)=0.119203 rather than rising materially with prefix.
best_checkpoint.pt::state_dict.ext_scale is 2.002089 and ext_shift is -3.601227, essentially their 2.0 and -3.6 initial values.
The run has only 180 optimizer steps at the locked 5e-5 learning rate, limiting adaptation of the newly added head.
causes.interpretation: A genuinely learned reliability gate is not supported. Although gradients reach the block and late dead-gradient fraction is zero, its output remains almost constant. The locked learning rate and short 180-step trajectory plausibly leave the newly initialized output layer near initialization; the gate needs a matched repair or ablation before its adaptive interpretation can be claimed.
missing_evidence: A matched repair that changes only gate parameterization or initialization while retaining the locked optimizer policy.
Saved per-sample gate values as a first-class run artifact rather than reviewer-side checkpoint evaluation.

contradicting_evidence: The selected epoch-7 checkpoint improves MAPE, RMSE, and Acc@15 over NA-E003, so checkpoint restoration captures a useful state before deterioration.
diagnostics.json$.summary.overall_gradient_health is HEALTHY and padding invariance is exact, ruling out numerical failure or mask leakage.
causes.interpretation: The six-cell split is unstable after selection: while train loss falls from 0.017423 at epoch 7 to 0.012097 at epoch 12, validation MAPE rises by 0.054935. This does not invalidate the selected checkpoint, but it makes cross-split confirmation essential and cautions against attributing the one-split gain solely to the new mechanism.
missing_evidence: Selected-checkpoint metrics and learning curves on splits 42 and 2024.
Three-split mean and sample standard deviation versus the NA-E003/004/005 parent configuration.

layers.name: curve_enc
layers.role: Encode each observed V/I/Q cycle into the learned per-cycle state inherited from NA-E003.
layers.reason: The inherited encoder is HEALTHY with late grad/parameter ratio 0.002124, update ratio 0.000365, zero near-zero-gradient fraction, and finite active outputs; the experiment provides no evidence for changing it.

layers.name: state_proj
layers.role: Fuse anchor-relative learned states and explicit capacity-fade ratios into the temporal state width.
layers.reason: The block is HEALTHY with late grad/parameter ratio 0.002277, update ratio 0.000366, no dead gradients, and fully active finite outputs.

layers.name: tcn_and_tcn_norm
layers.role: Read the masked anchor-relative fade trajectory through the inherited causal residual temporal stack.
layers.reason: Both blocks are connected and above dead/frozen thresholds; TCN late grad/parameter ratio is 0.002565, tcn_norm is 0.000103, both have nonzero updates and zero late near-zero-gradient fraction, and padding invariance is exact.

layers.name: parent_head
layers.role: Produce the inherited NaFadeNet prediction before extrapolation blending.
layers.reason: The parent head is HEALTHY with late grad/parameter ratio 0.004069, update ratio 0.000351, zero dead-gradient fraction, and finite active outputs.

layers.name: extrapolation_calibration
layers.role: Map the masked line-fit crossing estimate into standardized target space through ext_scale and ext_shift.
layers.reason: Both scalar parameters are connected and above frozen thresholds, and the combined screen improves materially. Their near-initial checkpoint values show that the useful result is approximately the proposed initial extrapolation mapping; cross-split confirmation is needed before changing it.

layers.name: gate
layers.role: Choose per sample how much of the mapped extrapolation estimate to blend with the parent prediction.
layers.reason: The block is connected but functionally remains at its approximately 0.12 initialization: prefix-band means span only 0.119412 to 0.120294 instead of rising materially with prefix. Preserve the candidate result, but do not claim adaptive gating; test a matched fixed-blend ablation or one gate-specific repair after cross-split confirmation.

screen_floor.reason: Confirmation run (training_stage full_candidate), not a screen.
